## Skillerr 0.1.9 — Your AI can attach files, with your OK

**New**
- **Attach images, videos and documents.** Your AI can now add files from your computer to a post or form (an image on
  X, Reddit, LinkedIn or Product Hunt, a document in a form) with the new `upload_file` tool, both from a file input
  and from buttons like "Add photos or video". Before, you had to do the upload by hand.
- **Every upload waits for you.** Skillerr asks next to the page, naming the files and the site, in every approval
  mode, and the Pilot panel logs it ("Attaching card-tabs.png to x.com"). Files in `~/.skillerr`, `~/.ssh`,
  keychains, password managers, browser profiles and other credential stores, and key files such as `.env` or
  `id_rsa`, are always refused. Try it on `demo/upload-demo.html`.

Installed copies on Windows, Linux AppImage, and signed Mac builds update themselves.
